risk_summary: The excerpt acknowledges sustained net operating losses over three years, concentrated in mortgage guaranty, title insurance, and consumer credit indemnity exposures, along with significant impairment and reserve-estimation risks. Management emphasizes long-term cycles and non-GAAP operating income, which may soften near-term performance interpretation, although the disclosure includes meaningful quantified detail on losses, impairments, DAC, and reinsurance recoverables.
